mapper.select: SELECT * FROM candidate_learning_session WHERE task_idtraining_id=#{taskId} AND token=#{token}

SELECT m.id,m.training_id trainingId,m.title,m.material_type materialType,m.page_count pageCount,m.preview_status previewStatus FROM training_material m JOIN training t ON t.id=m.training_id WHERE t.assessment_id=#{taskId}t.id=#{taskId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate_learning_session learner JOIN training_audience r ON r.candidate_name=learner.candidate_name AND r.phone=learner.phone WHERE learner.id=#{sessionId} AND r.training_id=t.id) ORDER BY t.id,m.sort_order,m.id

SELECT p.page_number pageNumber,p.required_seconds requiredSeconds,COALESCE(s.studied_seconds,0) studiedSeconds,COALESCE(s.completed,FALSE) completed FROM training_material_page p LEFT JOIN candidate_material_progress s ON s.material_id=p.material_id AND s.page_number=p.page_number AND s.session_id=#{sessionId} WHERE p.material_id=#{materialId} ORDER BY p.page_number

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_material m JOIN training t ON t.id=m.training_id WHERE m.id=#{materialId} AND t.assessment_id=#{taskId}t.id=#{taskId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate_learning_session learner JOIN training_audience r ON r.candidate_name=learner.candidate_name AND r.phone=learner.phone WHERE learner.id=#{sessionId} AND r.training_id=t.id) AND #{pageNumber} BETWEEN 1 AND m.page_count

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_material_page p WHERE p.material_id=#{materialId} AND p.page_number<#{pageNumber} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate_material_progress s WHERE s.session_id=#{sessionId} AND s.material_id=p.material_id AND s.page_number=p.page_number AND s.completed=TRUE)
SELECT id,preview_status FROM training_material WHERE id=#{materialId} FOR SHARE
SELECT id FROM candidate_learning_session WHERE id=#{sessionId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT s.*,p.required_seconds,GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,s.last_seen,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))/1000000.0) elapsed FROM candidate_material_progress s JOIN training_material_page p ON p.material_id=s.material_id AND p.page_number=s.page_number WHERE s.session_id=#{sessionId} AND s.material_id=#{materialId} AND s.page_number=#{pageNumber} FOR UPDATE OF s
mapper.update: UPDATE candidate_material_progress SET heartbeat_token=NULL WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND heartbeat_token IS NOT NULL

UPDATE candidate_material_progress SET consumed_heartbeat_token=#{consumedToken},consumed_seconds=#{consumedSeconds},studied_seconds=#{studiedSeconds},completed=#{completed},last_seen=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),heartbeat_token=#{heartbeatToken},completed_at=IF(#{markCompleted} AND completed_at IS NULL,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),completed_at) WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND material_id=#{materialId} AND page_number=#{pageNumber}
